operator_root.description: Absolute path to the operator workspace containing the kernel and bench sources.

kernel_source.description: Path (relative to operator_root) of the .metal source containing both variants.

bench_source.description: Path (relative to operator_root) of the Objective-C++ bench driver. It must accept --variant <name>, print a JSON result with gpu_median_ms and correct fields, and exit 2 on numeric failure.

build_args.description: Extra xcrun metal compile arguments. Defaults to -std=metal4.0 -mmacosx-version-min=27.0; relax for older targets.

bench_args.description: Arguments appended to every bench invocation, e.g. --m 1024 --n 5376 --k 5376 --group 64.

blocks.description: ABBA block count (default 4). Each block runs both variants with the configured iteration count.

iterations.description: Measured iterations per variant per block (default 10). One warmup run is always discarded.

output.description: Optional path for the full measurement record JSON. When absent the record is only echoed in the response.
